Workflow.Name: finalize-order
Workflow.Description: Records the outcome of the Order Evaluation Review step. A rejected order closes the instance; an approved order is rendered into an SAP sales order workbook by the SAP File Integration Agent, stored as a process artifact, and the instance is completed.
